verdict.rationale: ernd is a business card that pays rewards on AI-vendor spend. A fintech or corporate-card product could plausibly offer scoped API keys for agents, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers rewards rates, partner perks, fees and admin card requests; it documents no API, no credential issuance and no permission scoping. The probes hit developers.google.com rather than ernd and say nothing about ernd.
